app.name: Video Player
app.description: Play selected videos with subtitles, playlists and saved positions.

video.scope: Only selected files are accessible. Up to 20 playlists of 100 videos. Resume positions and settings are saved; videos are streamed from EveryOS, never copied into app storage.
video.permission: Video access needs files:pick permission from the App Store.
video.fullscreenError: Fullscreen was refused by this browser. Use the native video controls if available.
video.referencesOnly: Only playlist references are removed. Original files are not deleted.
video.revoked: Some playlist files are no longer shared. Add them again to restore access.
video.openHint: Choose a video through EveryOS. Playback depends on this browser’s containers and codecs; this app does not transcode.
video.captionHint: Plain-text WebVTT or SRT subtitles, up to 1 MiB and 2,000 cues. Markup and styling are not executed.
video.badSubtitles: Subtitles could not be read. Use valid WebVTT/SRT with at least one timed cue, at most 1 MiB and 2,000 cues.
video.unsupported: This file could not be played. Its codec/container may be unsupported, the file may be damaged, or its share may have expired. Try reloading or another browser/format. No transcoding is performed.
video.codecHint: These are the browser’s canPlayType reports, not a promise that a particular file will decode. Actual playback is decisive.
